run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/frontend-proxy since 2026-11-18T01:36:34Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The RequestErrorRate alert for otel-demo/frontend-proxy coincides with a large surge of failed requests that the trace data attribute to the ad service: frontend-proxy error spans rose from a 3-8 per 10-minute background to a peak of 1026 per 10-minute window at 01:51:34Z, and every one of those error spans is on operation "ingress" (server) or "router frontend egress" (client). In the same period the frontend service failed only on GET /api/data, exactly matching its client span grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds, and the ad service's own server span oteldemo.AdService/GetAds carried ~31-43 errors per minute (310-430 per 10-minute window). The ad pod ad-554b849958-sk6fg logged repeated "Exception while executing runnable io.grpc.internal.ServerImpl$JumpToApplicationThreadServerStreamListener$1HalfClosed@..." lines from 01:42:51Z, and chaos-mesh events show a Schedule otel-demo-ad-jvm-return in namespace chaos-mesh spawning a JVMChaos experiment every minute from 01:42:13Z to 01:51:13Z, each reporting "Successfully apply chaos for otel-demo/ad-554b849958-sk6fg/ad" and being recovered ~55 s later. All 21 otel-demo deployments were ready 1/1, all pods Running with 0 restarts, the flagd flags adFailure/adHighCpu/adManualGc were "off", and ad container CPU stayed at 0.006-0.021 cores, so restarts, flag-driven ad failure and CPU saturation are not supported as causes. Two points keep the conclusion partial: the alert's own rule (RequestErrorRate) is not present in the Prometheus rule set, and at the alert start 01:36:34Z the 5-minute trace-based error ratio for frontend-proxy returned 0, i.e. the visible error deviation in this data starts around 01:42-01:43, after the alert began; the chaos-mesh Schedule/JVMChaos specs could not be read, so the exact injected fault definition and any earlier experiments remain unverified.

claims.text: frontend-proxy error spans (status_code STATUS_CODE_ERROR) rose from a 3-8 per 10-minute background to 98.9 at 01:43:34Z, 300 at 01:46:34Z, peaked at 1026.3 at 01:51:34Z and were still 369.9 at 01:56:34Z, while STATUS_CODE_UNSET spans fell from ~14,700 to ~4,900 per 10 minutes over the same span; the error spans are the ones matching the alert's service_name label.

Within service frontend-proxy, all error spans are on exactly two span names: "ingress" (span_kind server) and "router frontend egress" (span_kind client, i.e. frontend-proxy calling frontend); their 10-minute error counts rose together from 8.4 at 01:43:34Z to 498.9/488.9 at 01:53:34Z.

In service frontend the only error-bearing operations are GET /api/data (server and "executing api route (pages) /api/data") and its client span grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds; their per-window error counts are identical (e.g. 349.5, 464.2, 431.9, 344.8, 226.3, 118.9 for the 10-minute windows ending 01:50-02:00), while GET /api/cart, POST /api/cart, POST /api/checkout, grpc.oteldemo.CartService/*, grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder and tcp.connect show 0 errors.

The ad service's own server span oteldemo.AdService/GetAds carried 310.5-430.8 error spans per 10-minute window between roughly 01:44Z and 02:00Z, and a 2-minute increase view of the same operation shows 56-68 errors per 2-minute window from about 01:44Z onward for frontend's client span grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds and 62.7-68 for ad's server span oteldemo.AdService/GetAds.

The ad container in pod otel-demo/ad-554b849958-sk6fg logged repeated error lines "Exception while executing runnable io.grpc.internal.ServerImpl$JumpToApplicationThreadServerStreamListener$1HalfClosed@<id>" starting at 01:42:51.566Z through 01:51:28.741Z, interleaved with normal lines such as "Targeted ad request received for [telescopes]" and "no baggage found in context".

Kubernetes events in namespace chaos-mesh show a chaos-mesh Schedule named otel-demo-ad-jvm-return generating one JVMChaos experiment per minute (otel-demo-ad-jvm-return-gbjlm at 01:42:13Z, 9f6n6 01:43:13Z, j2fmx 01:44:13Z, plmnp 01:45:13Z, ljkwf 01:46:13Z, dlm4f 01:47:13Z, 4x48z 01:48:13Z, m8wnc 01:49:13Z, gzz89 01:50:13Z, 2xnmj 01:51:13Z), and each experiment reported "Successfully apply chaos for otel-demo/ad-554b849958-sk6fg/ad" and then TimeUp/Recovered about 50-55 s later (e.g. Applied 01:42:23Z, TimeUp 01:43:08Z, Recovered 01:43:10Z).

All 21 workloads in namespace otel-demo were ready 1/1 with no unavailable replicas (including ad, frontend and frontend-proxy), and pod ad-554b849958-sk6fg was Running, ready, with restartCount 0 and startTime 2026-11-18T01:06:18Z; the event grouping across all namespaces returned no Pod events for namespace otel-demo.

The otel-demo flagd-config ConfigMap holds flags adFailure, adHighCpu and adManualGc, each with defaultVariant "off" and variants off=false / on=true, plus cartFailure, paymentFailure, productCatalogFailure, recommendationCacheFailure and others also at defaultVariant "off".

ad container CPU usage (rate of container_cpu_usage_seconds_total) was 0.0046-0.0098 cores per second through 01:38Z and 0.0108-0.0210 cores per second between 01:44Z and 01:52Z, i.e. a small rise far from saturation.

A 5-minute trace-based error-ratio query for frontend-proxy (100 * error spans / all spans from traces_span_metrics_calls_total) evaluated at the alert start 2026-11-18T01:36:34Z returned 0, so the trace-span data shows no elevated frontend-proxy error ratio in the 01:31:34Z-01:36:34Z window.

frontend-proxy total span volume per 10-minute window changed during the window: 5020.1 (ending 00:41:34Z), 11699.2 (00:46:34Z), 14146.3 (00:51:34Z), 12895.4 (00:56:34Z), 14773.7 (01:01:34Z), 12891.9 (01:06:34Z), 14228.4 (01:11:34Z), 9335.3 (01:16:34Z) - the last values reflect falling request-span volume near 01:56Z.

No pod restart, eviction or OOM evidence was found for the affected and upstream services: ad-554b849958-sk6fg and all otel-demo pods were Running/ready with restartCount 0, all deployments including frontend and frontend-proxy had readyReplicas 1 and availableReplicas 1, and the all-namespace event grouping contained no Pod events in namespace otel-demo.

Feature-flag-driven ad failure (flagd adFailure) is rejected as this incident's cause: the flag's defaultVariant is "off" in the flagd-config ConfigMap, and no error response is visible on ad's flagd calls (flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/ResolveBoolean shows 0 errors while the failures are on oteldemo.AdService/GetAds).

CPU saturation / JVM-high-CPU on the ad service is rejected: adHighCpu is "off" and ad container CPU stayed between 0.0046 and 0.0210 cores per second across 01:22Z-01:52Z, while the error rate jumped by two orders of magnitude.

The ad service's failing oteldemo.AdService/GetAds calls are caused by the chaos-mesh Schedule otel-demo-ad-jvm-return repeatedly injecting a JVM-level fault into pod otel-demo/ad-554b849958-sk6fg container ad: the first applied experiment (01:42:23Z) precedes both the ad exception log lines (from 01:42:51Z) and the rise in ad/frontend/frontend-proxy error spans (from the 01:43:34Z evaluation), and frontend-proxy/frontend errors are confined to the AdService call path. The Schedule/JVMChaos specs were not readable, so the injected action itself was not verified.

gaps: No Prometheus rule named RequestErrorRate exists in the registered Prometheus (list_prometheus_rules with rule_name=RequestErrorRate returned nothing), so the alert's expression, its 0 threshold and the annotation value 2.1111 could not be verified; the alert may be evaluated outside this Prometheus.

The chaos-mesh Schedule otel-demo-ad-jvm-return and its JVMChaos children could not be read (chaos-mesh CR kinds are not in the readable kind list), so the injected action (the name suggests jvm-return), its selector, duration and whether experiments ran before 01:42:13Z remain unknown; the first chaos-mesh event returned is 01:42:13Z.

The alert start 01:36:34Z precedes the first observed chaos application (01:42:23Z) by about 6 minutes and the trace-based frontend-proxy error ratio at 01:36:34Z was 0; what made the alert fire at that moment is not established by this evidence.

A filtered log query on ad-554b849958-sk6fg for 'Exception' over 01:20:00Z-01:42:00Z returned no lines; an empty result shows only that this query matched nothing, so the absence of ad exceptions before 01:42 is not proven.

The change_history integration is not available, so configuration/rollout changes in the window cannot be checked; a rollout is separately rendered unlikely by the 0 restarts and unchanged 2.1.3 image digests.

load-generator has no series in traces_span_metrics_calls_total (its service_name is absent from the returned label values), so the fall in frontend-proxy request-span volume near 01:56Z (14773.7 to 9335.3 per 10 minutes) cannot be attributed to the load generator or to the ad failures from this data.
next_steps: Read the chaos-mesh Schedule otel-demo-ad-jvm-return and its JVMChaos resources (spec action, targets, duration, creation time) to confirm the injected JVM fault and whether it started before 01:42:13Z.

Locate the RequestErrorRate alerting rule in the Alertmanager/Prometheus configuration that actually evaluates it, to confirm which metric and window produced the annotation value 2.1111 at 01:36:34Z.
Compare the load-generator's own logs and request counts around 01:50-02:00Z to determine whether the frontend-proxy request-volume drop is a client-side effect or part of the same incident.
